text: Transportation Services recommends that a portion of Dundas Street West abutting 3819 Bloor Street West be permanently closed in connection with the City-initiated Six Points Interchange Reconfiguration Project.

City Council on March 27 and 28, 2019, adopted the following: 1. City Council authorize the permanent closure of the portion of Dundas Street West abutting 3819 Bloor Street West designated as Parts 3 and 4 on Reference Plan 66R-30521, and also shown as Parts 3 and 4 on Sketch No. PS-2017-110 (the "Highway Lands"), attached as Appendices B and C, respectively, to the report (March 1, 2019) from the Director, Transportation Planning and Capital Program, Transportation Services. 2. City Council enact a by-law substantially in the form of the draft by-law attached as Appendix A to the report (March 1, 2019) from the Director, Transportation Planning and Capital Program, Transportation Services.
